conversion_policy: Cross-system conversion is not supported and is never implied by a shared field name, die shape, or system label. Moving data between adapters requires a separately approved migration; this build declares none. Without one, every adapter definition and state is archived unchanged under its own namespace.
migration_policy: Only a same-adapter release change may declare a migration. A migration must set reviewed and preserves_canonical_character to true, match the source adapter id, version requirement, and schema version, and pass a dry run against the target schema. A cross-system switch is never a migration.

adapters.title: Plug-And-Play compatible adapter
adapters.compatibility_label: Compatible with the CC0 Plug-And-Play rules; not endorsed by its creator
required_notices: The official PDFs are hash-pinned inputs and are not redistributed with Weave.
Factual compatibility naming does not imply sponsorship or endorsement.

adapters.title: Dungeonpunk compatible adapter
adapters.compatibility_label: Compatible with the CC0 Dungeonpunk core rules; not endorsed by its creators
required_notices: The official release page is https://acegiak.itch.io/dungeonpunk.
The official PDF and text exports are audit inputs and are not redistributed with Weave.
The community wiki and every third-party supplement remain outside this adapter's reviewed source boundary.

adapters.title: Freehack 2.1 adapter
required_notices: Only hashes and independently authored behavior are bundled; the upstream PDF, icon, stylesheet, and page layout are excluded.
Freehack public payloads must be produced by the dedicated projection API; generic receipt projection retains host-event envelopes and is not a player transport.

adapters.title: Wicked Ones v1.4 adapter
required_notices: War for the Overworld and Undead Awakening content remains owned by its author and is denied by this adapter; no such material appears in this module or its fixtures.
The primary digest covers the checked-in SOURCE_RECORD.txt text record, not a downloaded rulebook. The record states the canonical URL, CC0-1.0 licence, and v1.4 edition.

adapters.title: Spark adapter
adapters.compatibility_label: Compatible with The Spark Roleplaying Game core rules
required_notices: Only independently authored core-mechanics behavior and the in-module source record are bundled; no downloaded upstream file is redistributed.
Spark example settings, logos, artwork, fonts, and presentation layout are excluded.
The manifest digest is the SHA-256 of SPARK_SOURCE_RECORD, not of an upstream download.

adapters.title: Open Adventure: Fantasy adapter
adapters.compatibility_label: Compatible with Open Adventure: Fantasy Community-Owned Content
required_notices: The provenance digest is the SHA-256 of the in-repository OPEN_ADVENTURE_SOURCE_RECORD string, not of a downloaded upstream file.
Masterwork Edition layout, third-party products, unmarked content, community additions, logos, artwork, and trade dress are excluded from the reviewed boundary.

adapters.title: Open Tale adapter
adapters.compatibility_label: Compatible with the Open Tale public rules reference
required_notices: The complete Apache-2.0 license text is retained in LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt and in OPEN_TALE_LICENSE_TEXT.
This adapter does not redistribute upstream text, artwork, fonts, or layout; only independently authored integration code, formulas, and fixtures are bundled.
No upstream NOTICE file is known for the public rules reference; this notice records the attribution and modification boundary instead.
